text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data instead of being programmed with fixed rules. Deep learning, a more advanced method, uses layers of artificial neural networks to process large amounts of information, similar to how the human brain works. You already use AI every day—when your phone suggests the next word in a message, when a streaming service recommends a movie, or when a car uses navigation to avoid traffic. These systems improve over time, making our lives more convenient and efficient.
